note: 20ª vaga (2026-08-28, Fase 19) — ambiente/sustentabilidade, categoria temática praticamente ausente até agora (só drought/flood/recycle/pollution existiam isolados), tema atual e relevante a nível B1-C1. Todos os headwords confirmados novos por grep antes de escrever este ficheiro.

words.definition_en: a wireless technology used to connect devices to the internet
example_sentences: Is there free wifi here?

words.definition_en: long-term changes in temperature and weather patterns, largely caused by human activity
example_sentences: Scientists agree that climate change is accelerating.

words.definition_en: able to continue over time without causing long-term damage to the environment
example_sentences: The company switched to more sustainable packaging.

words.definition_en: the ability to be maintained without depleting natural resources
example_sentences: Sustainability is now central to the company's strategy.

words.definition_en: describing a natural resource that is not depleted when used, such as sunlight or wind
example_sentences: We get most of our electricity from renewable sources.

words.definition_en: energy from sources that are naturally replenished, like sun, wind, or water
example_sentences: The country invested heavily in renewable energy.

words.definition_en: the total amount of greenhouse gases produced by a person or organisation's activities
example_sentences: Flying less is one way to reduce your carbon footprint.

words.definition_en: a gas, such as carbon dioxide, that traps heat in the Earth's atmosphere
example_sentences: Cars are a major source of greenhouse gases.

words.definition_en: the warming of the Earth's surface caused by gases trapping heat in the atmosphere
example_sentences: The greenhouse effect is a natural process, but human activity is intensifying it.

words.definition_en: a type of animal or plant that is at risk of disappearing completely
example_sentences: The panda used to be an endangered species.

words.definition_en: a fire that spreads quickly and uncontrollably, especially in a rural area
example_sentences: Wildfires destroyed thousands of hectares of forest last summer.

words.definition_en: a device that converts sunlight into electricity
example_sentences: They installed solar panels on the roof.

words.definition_en: a large structure with blades that generates electricity from wind
example_sentences: You can see wind turbines along the coast.

words.definition_en: a car powered by electricity instead of petrol or diesel
example_sentences: More people are buying electric cars every year.

words.definition_en: plastic material that has been thrown away
example_sentences: Plastic waste is a major problem in the oceans.

words.definition_en: a site where waste is buried in the ground
example_sentences: Most of our rubbish still ends up in landfill.

words.definition_en: decayed organic material used to improve soil, or to make it
example_sentences: We compost our food scraps in the garden.

words.definition_en: the variety of plant and animal life in a particular habitat
example_sentences: The rainforest has incredible biodiversity.

words.definition_en: the cutting down and clearing of forests
example_sentences: Deforestation is a major cause of habitat loss.

words.definition_en: the process of planting trees in an area where forest was destroyed
example_sentences: The government funded a large reforestation project.

words.definition_en: the gradual increase in the Earth's overall temperature
example_sentences: Global warming is affecting weather patterns worldwide.

words.definition_en: fuel such as coal, oil, or gas formed from the remains of ancient organisms
example_sentences: We still rely heavily on fossil fuels for energy.

words.definition_en: gases or particles released into the air, especially pollutants
example_sentences: The new law aims to reduce car emissions.

words.definition_en: having a net-zero amount of carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere
example_sentences: The airline promised to become carbon neutral by 2040.

words.definition_en: plastic items designed to be used once and then thrown away
example_sentences: The city banned single-use plastic bags.

words.definition_en: not harmful to the environment
example_sentences: We try to buy eco-friendly products.

words.definition_en: able to decompose naturally without harming the environment
example_sentences: These bags are fully biodegradable.

words.definition_en: the level of pollutants present in the air
example_sentences: Air quality in the city has improved in recent years.

words.definition_en: a lack of enough fresh water to meet demand
example_sentences: Water scarcity affects millions of people worldwide.

words.definition_en: a sudden natural event, like an earthquake or flood, that causes great damage
example_sentences: The region has suffered several natural disasters this decade.

words.definition_en: a period of unusually hot weather
example_sentences: A heatwave hit the country in July.

words.definition_en: the gradual increase in the height of the ocean, linked to climate change
example_sentences: Rising sea levels threaten many coastal cities.

words.definition_en: the protection of the natural environment and wildlife
example_sentences: The charity works on wildlife conservation.

words.definition_en: catching fish faster than they can reproduce, reducing their population
example_sentences: Overfishing has reduced cod populations dramatically.

words.definition_en: the layer of the atmosphere that protects the Earth from harmful UV radiation
example_sentences: The hole in the ozone layer has been slowly recovering.

words.definition_en: using less energy to achieve the same result
example_sentences: We bought a more energy efficient fridge.

words.definition_en: an action, such as planting trees, that counteracts a certain amount of carbon emissions
example_sentences: The airline lets passengers buy carbon offsets for their flights.

words.definition_en: development that meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet theirs
example_sentences: The conference focused on sustainable development goals.

words.definition_en: not harmful to the natural environment
example_sentences: The new factory uses environmentally friendly processes.
